Variants.Content: The faith of R'hllor understands the world as an eternal war between the Lord of Light and the forces of darkness, with fire as a symbol of worship, warmth, and hope, as well as divination, sacrifice, and unsettling power. Red priests through bonfires, prophecies, healing legends and public rituals attracts believers; port workers, slaves, and those frustrated in the war may see hope in changing their destiny, while bachelors and old nobles often doubt its miracles and costs. What believers truly believe, and what the flames actually manifest, cannot always be proven.
